programs.title: Bones
programs.sub_title: The Memories In The Shallow Grave
programs.desc: Brennan and Booth adjust to their new life as an expectant couple, and deal with forthcoming changes in their in their home life. Meanwhile, when the Jeffersonian team identifies a woman's remains found in a paintball field, they discover two missing persons reports in her file. Booth and Sweets interrogate the victim's husband, and learn that she suffered from amnesia. When Squint Wendell Bray learns that the victim also survived a bullet wound, inconsistencies in her medical records uncover a surprising crime linked to her murder.
